style_scaffold.look: editorial monochrome, fine grain, shallow depth of field

narration.note: Placed by voice onset, not by file start: line two leads its picture cut on purpose, so the audio binds the edit instead of slicing it.

lines.line: The kettle boiled twice before anyone noticed.
So most mornings, it just sits there.

shots.visual: a phone face down beside a cold cup of coffee
shots.motion_prompt: the screen lights once under the table edge and goes dark again
shots.audio_bed: room tone with a distant street hum

shots.visual: a draft post open with the cursor blinking mid-sentence
shots.motion_prompt: the cursor deletes the last clause and stops
shots.audio_bed: soft key press and room tone

shots.visual: hands closing a laptop at a kitchen table
shots.motion_prompt: the hands lower the lid and rest flat on it
shots.audio_bed: a music bed rising under the last line
